metadata.question: In November 2021, did Seattle experience less than 20cm of rainfall?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about rainfall in Seattle in November 2021, specifically whether it was less than 20cm. I need to: 1. Find precipitation data - GPM (Global Precipitation Measurement) IMERG data would be good for this 2. Define Seattle geometry (I'll use a point with buffer) 3. Filter for November 2021 4. Sum the precipitation for the month and convert to cm 5. Check if it's less than 20cm For data quality: - Use GPM IMERG daily data (NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_DAILY_V06) which has 'precipitation' band in mm - Sum daily precipitation for the month - Convert mm to cm (divide by 10) - Check if collection is empty - Check if valid pixels exist - Validate the result is reasonable The GPM IMERG data provides precipitation in mm, so I'll sum the daily values for November 2021 and convert to cm. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const seattle = ee.Geometry.Point([-122.3321, 47.6062]).buffer(10000); // 10km buffer around Seattle const startDate = '2021-11-01'; const endDate = '2021-11-30'; // 2. Data Acquisition - GPM IMERG Daily Precipitation const precipCol = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_DAILY_V06') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(seattle); const colSize = precipCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`November 2021 precipitation images: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Sum daily precipitation for the month const monthlyPrecip = precipCol.sum(); // Check valid pixels const pixelCount = monthlyPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: seattle, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels in region: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Get mean precipitation in mm and convert to cm const precipMm = monthlyPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: seattle, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); const precipCm = precipMm / 10; // Convert mm to cm // 5. Validation & Final Answer console.log(`Total November 2021 rainfall: ${precipCm.toFixed(2)} cm`); if (precipCm === null || precipCm === undefined || isNaN(precipCm) || precipCm < 0 || precipCm > 1000) { console.log("C3"); } else if (precipCm < 20) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
